description: Code the harness runs at a fixed lifecycle event (session start, prompt submit, before or after a tool, stop), every time, regardless of what the model decided.
Runs after the model proposes a call and before it executes; it can continue, block with a reason, or rewrite the arguments.
Runs after the tool and before the model sees the result; it can pass, replace (redact, truncate) or record the output.
Selects which tools a hook applies to: one name, a list such as `Edit|Write`, or `*`.
A hook that throws, times out or returns an invalid result counts as a block, and its output is withheld.
Replacing secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys) in tool output with a placeholder before they reach the context, logs or traces.
A post-tool hook that records which tool ran with which arguments, for later review; it should run after redaction.
